meta.title: Cuadre · Expense tracker
meta.description: Track your expenses, income and debts from any device.

auth.signupLead: The same account works on your phone and your computer.
auth.forgotLead: We'll send you a link to create a new password.
auth.resetLead: Type the password you'll use from now on.
auth.checkEmail: Check your email: we sent you a link to confirm your account.
auth.resetSent: If that email has an account, a link will arrive in a few minutes.
auth.linkError: The link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.

summary.title: Summary
summary.overallHint: Everything that came in minus everything that went out.
summary.totalHint: The sum of all your accounts and pockets. Credit cards subtract.

tx.title: Transactions
tx.confirmDelete: Really delete? This can't be undone.
tx.emptyHint: Add the first one with the Add button.
tx.needAccount: Create an account first to log transactions.

debts.title: Debts
debts.confirmDelete: The debt and all its payments will be deleted.
debts.emptyOwed: Nobody owes you money right now.
debts.emptyHint: When you lend or borrow, write it down here and log the payments as they come.
debts.noPayments: No payments yet. Log the first one when you pay or get paid.
debts.notFound: This debt doesn't exist or was deleted.

settings.title: Settings
settings.currencyHint: Used to display all your figures. It doesn't convert amounts already saved.

errors.save: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again.
errors.delete: Couldn't delete. Check your connection and try again.
errors.amount: Enter an amount greater than zero, with up to 2 decimals.
errors.email: Enter a valid email, like name@email.com.
errors.passwordShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.passwordWeak: That password is too easy to guess. Try a longer one.
errors.samePassword: The new password must be different from the old one.
errors.notConfirmed: Confirm your account first with the link we emailed you.
errors.rateLimit: Too many emails were sent. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.signup: Couldn't create the account. If you already have one, sign in.
errors.loadBody: Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.sameAccount: Pick a different account than the one it comes from.
errors.accountName: Enter a name for the account.
errors.parent: Pick which account this pocket belongs to.
errors.accountInUse: This account has activity. Archive it to hide it without losing its history.

setup.title: The database isn't connected yet
setup.lead: The app needs a free Supabase project to store your data and handle sign-in.
setup.step1: Create a project at supabase.com (Free plan).
setup.step2: In the SQL Editor, paste and run the file supabase/schema.sql.
setup.step3: Copy the project URL and the public key into .env.local (see .env.example).
setup.step4: Restart the server with npm run dev.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.name: Name
accounts.initialHint: What it has today, according to your bank app. You can change it later.
accounts.initialCreditHint: The card's used balance. It will show as negative.
accounts.pockets: {count, plural, =0 {No pockets} one {# pocket} other {# pockets}}
accounts.noMovements: This account has no activity in {month}.
accounts.confirmDelete: The account and its pockets will be deleted. Only possible if they have no activity.
accounts.confirmArchive: The account stops showing when logging transactions. Its history is kept.
accounts.notFound: This account doesn't exist or was deleted.
accounts.emptyTitle: Add your accounts to get started
accounts.emptyBody: Pick the ones you use. Then set what each one has today.
accounts.orCustom: Another account? Add it your way.
accounts.setBalances: Now set each account's balance: tap the account, then Edit account.
accounts.noPockets: Set money aside inside this account: rent, trip, savings…
